note: Only numbers stated by the cited sources. Areas for each lake come from ONE source (never mixed). Satellite estimates; watch only, not a flood warning.

lakes.name: Vasudhara Tal
lakes.areaSource: Pandey A. (2026), Open Geosciences 18(1), Table 1 (lake L55). The paper's text gives 0.622 km² for 2023.
lakes.growth: 50 साल में ~4 गुना · about 4× in 50 years; +171% in 2001–2011 alone.
lakes.fieldNote: USDMA field team, Oct 2026: about 900 m × 600 m, 38.5 m deep, no big change in size recently.
lakes.risk: NDMA Category A (the only one in Chamoli). Held back only by moraine. USDMA installed the state's first sensor early-warning system here in 2026.
lakes.downstream: रैकाणा → धौलीगंगा → मलारी, रैणी, तपोवन → विष्णुप्रयाग (NH-7, जोशीमठ के पास)

lakes.name: Balbala Lake
lakes.areaSource: Pandey A. (2026), Open Geosciences 18(1), section 4.1 and Table 1. Named in this one paper only.
lakes.growth: 1980 के आसपास बनी, 2023 तक ~8.6 गुना · formed around 1980, about 8.6× bigger by 2023.
lakes.fieldNote: Checked in the field on 9 Oct 2019 (the only lake the paper visited).
lakes.risk: GLOF susceptibility 0.855 (very high): ice calves into it, rockfall and debris land in it, the moraine outlet is unstable.
lakes.downstream: माणा → बदरीनाथ की ओर (पेपर के अनुसार बदरीनाथ की तरफ़)

lakes.name: Chorabari Tal (Gandhi Sarovar)
lakes.areaSource: No source gives an area in km². Before 2013: about 400 m × 200 m, 15–20 m deep (Dobhal et al. 2013, Current Science 105(2)).
lakes.growth: 16–17 जून 2013 को टूटी, 5–10 मिनट में खाली; फिर नहीं भरी · burst in June 2013, drained in 5–10 minutes, never refilled.
lakes.fieldNote: Today a flat area of boulders with a small stream.
lakes.risk: What a lake outburst does to a Char Dham road: the 2013 flood wiped out Kedarnath town and the Kedarnath–Gaurikund route.
